faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Publishing requests is free for companies. We charge a commission on the confirmed service price, shown transparently before you accept.
faq.q2: Which areas does LoadMatch currently operate in?
faq.a2: We currently operate across Metropolitan Lima and Callao. We are gradually expanding to other regions of Peru.
faq.a3: We verify MTC authorisation, current SOAT insurance, technical inspection and driving licence against official records before a carrier can quote.
faq.q4: What happens if there is an incident during the shipment?
faq.a4: You can report the incident from the application. Our support team follows up on the case and records it in the carrier's history.
faq.q5: What types of cargo can I ship?
faq.a5: General packaged goods, palletised loads and dry merchandise. Hazardous, perishable and oversized cargo are not supported yet.
